one_liner: Dyson Daniels shoots 61.1 percent from the free-throw line -- the weakest line in this marquee set -- while contributing 6.7 rebounds and 5.2 assists per 36 minutes.
three_things: 61.1 percent from the stripe is a genuine constraint on the offensive role.
The value shows up elsewhere: 6.7 rebounds and 5.2 assists per 36 from a guard.
Scoring stays low at 13 points per 36 on 29.6 percent from three.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. This manifest has no defensive columns -- steals, deflections, and matchup data are simply absent, so nothing here speaks to the part of his game most often discussed.
